rationale: The workflow runs Gradle builds on Linux, Windows, and macOS without any dependency cache step. Evidence from P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) shows adding actions/cache for ~/.gradle/caches after Gradle setup and before the build reduced median elapsed time by about 20% while preserving all build/test steps. The pattern preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs across jobs, and cache inputs include the lockfile/gradle-wrapper properties. No existing cache step is present. The change adds only the standard actions/cache@v4 action (GitHub's own cache service, no external network beyond Gradle's existing dependency downloads, no privileged actions, secrets, or deployment operations), preserves every build/test/archive step and required check, and is placed before the build step in each job. For FreeBSD the cache path matches the job's GRADLE_USER_HOME override (.gradle-user-home).
